review: Match 1 settled agent-one equity at 1000, zero trades, zero failures, zero return and zero marked drawdown. Benchmark equity was 1060.8345799969377 (+6.0834579997%); benchmark gap was -6.0834579997 percentage points. Valid abstention avoided execution risk but missed a positive benchmark move. Weaknesses: the 20-bar component can delay participation after a reversal, and half-capital sizing further limits upside capture. One match cannot establish signal quality; the proposed test changes only the slow signal component, not exposure. No independent same-window judge replay is available.
hypothesis: On all public-prefix decisions t=20..52, replacing the equal-weight 10/20-bar gate with r10>0.006 while retaining r5>0 and identical sizing will increase mean seven-bar net profit, with worst-case loss deterioration <=10 dollars per 1000-dollar isolated episode. No parameter sweep; retain parent unless both conditions pass.
changes: Revise the offline candidate: replace score=(r10+r20)/2>0.006 with r10>0.006, retaining r5>0. No threshold search; identical 21-close warmup, 500-dollar decision-close budget, 1.10 fill buffer, rounding, fee and slippage assumptions. Metadata identifies the offline candidate. Original v1 preserved byte-for-byte. Only one candidate was evaluated; adoption is provisional and no live submission or infrastructure was changed.
shared_tips: For the other agent: use identical decision prefixes, warmup, next-close fills and fee/slippage assumptions when comparing revisions; otherwise apparent alpha can come from lookahead or execution mismatches rather than a better signal.

For the other agent: report both overlapping rolling episodes and a nonoverlapping diagnostic, because nearby holding windows share returns and can exaggerate effective evidence. A small historical gain is not independent validation.

For the other agent: treat a fixed sizing buffer as a heuristic rather than a feasibility guarantee; a next-close price jump can still breach cash, so explicitly count rejected fills and keep leverage prohibited.
result_interpretation: The predeclared historical criterion passed: 33 paired episodes, old mean net profit -1.8888865788 dollars versus new -1.3252441858 dollars, improvement 0.5636423929 dollars per 1000-dollar reset episode. Both worst profits -31.9127139034 dollars and maximum episode marked drawdowns 3.1912713903%; neither had rejected fills. Entry counts 4 versus 6. Both mean profits remain negative and below the local benchmark mean (-0.0840714301 dollars). Five stride-seven episodes show no difference. This is weak, overlapping, in-sample evidence for a provisional offline revision, not evidence of recovered match profit, statistical significance or future superiority.
provenance: Public scoreboard reviewed before hypothesis registration. preregistered-hypothesis.json written before compiling/executing the single candidate. Replay uses only copied round-0 public bars t=0..59; decision t=20..52, next-close fill t+1 and terminal mark t+7. No post-decision observations are passed to either strategy. Public settlement evidence was read for execution rules/review but no t>=60 prices enter data or tests. Agent-reported local replay only; independent matched judge replay unavailable. Later adaptation remains allowed, with new provenance required.
